messages:
margo: starting a staggered warmup for the US -> EU -> APAC rollout. tagging @liam @anita for capacity signoff.
liam: US warm pool provisioned at 110%, canary=4%. Running quick smoke.
anita: EU pinned to v2.4.1 for canary gating, reserved +12%. APAC standby nodes booting (ETA 7m).
deploy-bot: deploy start | release=2026-03-staggered | regions=[us,eu,apac] | canary=4% | rollout=sequential | initiated_by=@margo
liam: US smoke OK, sample latency 130ms p95 280ms. No errors.
anita: EU dashboards up, muted autoscale for 10m. Will run eval at 5% traffic.
ops-oncall: PD on for EU/APAC. thermal thresholds set. fallback route prepared: `route/weight { new:0, old:100 }`.
liam: ramping US to 8% now.
anita: EU 5% canary smoke passed. Eval started.
margo: Hold 15m on US then proceed EU->APAC. Rollback triggers: >3% error or sustained p50>320ms 3m. If hit, immediate pinback and PD.
deploy-bot: region-update | us:canary=8%:ok | eu:canary=5%:ok | apac:canary=0%:pending
anita: Eval 5% delta +0.6% — within gate. Proceeding to 12% after hold.
ops-oncall: APAC nodes healthy, thermal 22%. Ready for gradual ramp when EU stable.
margo: good. schedule 30m retro after close. keep chatter light in channel while we watch metrics.
